items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: a lot of the old timers, Mario Bauza, says, “You know what? If you think it’s that bad, it’s really not.

ctx.x: That’s not bad. That’s not bad. I have to thank God for everything that’s happened to me. And a lot of the old timers, Mario Bauza, says, “You know what? If you think it’s that bad, it’s really not. And if you have faith, intelligence and a sense of humor you can overcome anything.” So those are good advice, for everyone.
Well it sounds like a good place to wrap this up.
